'''Feral Humans''' are the [[Feral Parasites|Feral Versions]] of Zombies and Husks. 

== ''Spawning'' ==

* Spawned when a Zombie or Husk is killed by a [[Gnat]] or [[Lice]].
* Spawns from a Zombie or Husk succumbing to [[Call Of The Hive]] at [[Evolution Phases#Phase 7|Phase 7]] onwards.
* Spawns when an [[Assimilated Human]] accumulates a killcount of 60 and [[Evolution System|evolves]].
* Spawns in groups of 4 to 5, from [[Evolution Phases#Phase 8|Phase 8]] onwards, with a spawnweight of 25, once 5 Zombies/Husks have been assimilated.

== ''Behavior'' ==
Feral Humans are melee combatants.

* Feral Humans attack through contact damage.
* Feral Humans can perform small leaps, both on land and in liquids.
* Feral Humans are able to sink in liquids to pursue submerged targets.
* On hit Feral Humans has a chance to drop [[Remains|Feral Remains]].

===''Weaknesses''===
*Feral Humans, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.

=== ''Post Death'' ===

* On death Feral Humans have a chance to explode, releasing [[Remains|Assimilated Remains]] and an effect cloud of stacking Poison and [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]].
* On death Feral Humans have a chance to drop a [[Gnat]].
